issues.title: As a member of game management team I wish to be able to un-claim a document
issues.body:
In collaborative working, once an document has been `claimed` by someone, or `assigned` to someone it can't be claimed by someone else.

If someone has left the game, then that message can't be moved forward.

So, some individuals in senior roles should be able to un-claim a document.  The setting would be `per-channel`, since Blue CO may wish to do it for COAs, but not for RFIs.

I propose this is _another_ toggle button to go into the `Special Channels` role edit panel in `Game Admin`.

* [x] Change typescript to include new boolean for channel `collabOptions`. Titled `canUnclaim`
* [ ] Change game admin UI to include above toggle if this is a special channel. Icon to be `user-lock` icon, with tooltip "Able to un-claim documents".
* [x] Change COA Status Board logic to include un-claim for roles with above flag.
* [x] Update the wargame design so that Red Leader & Deputy can un-claim for Red COAs, Blue Lead for Blue COAs, and both J2 roles for Blue and Red RFIs.
